name: dsh-remote-gateway
description: Public TLS gateway for DSH Remote: routes /connect and /api/* to the right desktop DSH by token/cookie, bridges WebSockets to desktop relay connectors, and serves a category-ID resource centre (dsh-remote/smartbill/relay/docs) with a JSON index, per-upload keepVersions retention and token-authenticated upload/delete.

scripts.check: node --check gateway.mjs && node --check proto.mjs && node --check config.mjs && node --check identity.mjs && node --check downloads.mjs && node --check download-page.mjs && node --check compress.mjs && node --check resources.mjs && node --check resources-http.mjs
